svg.aria-label: Routing between autonomous systems: inside each AS an intra-domain protocol such as OSPF finds paths; between ASes, BGP sessions advertise reachable prefixes with their AS path, and each AS picks routes by its own policy, such as preferring customers over peers over providers.
svg.title: Routing between autonomous systems: inside each AS an intra-domain protocol such as OSPF finds paths; between ASes, BGP sessions advertise reachable prefixes with their AS path, and each AS picks routes by its own policy, such as preferring customers over peers over providers.
svg.text: Advertisement flows right → left: "8.8.8.0/24, AS path 300" → "8.8.8.0/24, AS path 200 300". Each AS chooses by policy, then shortest AS path.
